description: This file contains a C# class 'SerializerGenerator' within the 'Orleans.CodeGenerator' namespace. The class is responsible for generating serializer classes for types, including methods for serialize/deserialize, managing internal fields, constructors, and handling various type-specific behaviors like enums, abstract types, and generics. It also defines several internal classes representing descriptions of generated fields and members, as well as detailed implementations of member handling for serialization purposes.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating serializer classes for various types, including methods for serialization/deserialization, field management, and supporting type-specific behaviors like enums and abstract types.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator.GeneratedFieldDescription
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a description of a generated field within the serializer class.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator.BaseCodecFieldDescription
classes.description: A description of the base codec field used in generated serializers.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator.ActivatorFieldDescription
classes.description: A description of an activator field used for object creation.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator.CodecFieldDescription
classes.description: A description of a codec field, including underlying type information.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator.TypeFieldDescription
classes.description: A description of a type-related field, including underlying type info.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator.CodecFieldTypeFieldDescription
classes.description: A description for the codec type field in the generated code.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator.FieldAccessorDescription
classes.description: Describes accessors (getter/setter) for a member, potentially initialized via expressions.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator.ISerializableMember
classes.description: Interface representing a serializable member (field/property) of a type, with details for serialization and member access.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator.SerializableMethodMember
classes.description: Implementation of ISerializableMember based on method parameters, representing a member invoked via methods.

classes.name: SerializerGenerator.SerializableMember
classes.description: Implementation of ISerializableMember representing a field/property in a type, with logic for accessing and serialization.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Main method producing a class declaration syntax for a given type description, handling various type characteristics such as enums, abstract types, generics, and including serializers for members.

methods.name: GetFieldDeclarations
methods.description: Creates an array of field declaration syntax nodes based on field descriptions.

methods.name: GenerateConstructor
methods.description: Builds a constructor syntax node for the generated serializer class, wiring up injected or provider-based fields.

methods.name: GetFieldDescriptions
methods.description: Creates descriptions of fields for the serializer class based on the type description and its members.

methods.name: GenerateSerializeMethod
methods.description: Constructs the 'Serialize' method syntax node, implementing the serialization logic for the type.

methods.name: AddSerializationCallbacks
methods.description: Adds calls to serialization lifecycle hooks (e.g., OnSerializing) if defined.

methods.name: GenerateDeserializeMethod
methods.description: Builds the 'Deserialize' method syntax node, implementing deserialization logic.

methods.name: GenerateEnumWriteMethod
methods.description: Generates method for writing enum values using the associated codec.

methods.name: GenerateEnumReadMethod
methods.description: Generates method for reading enum values.

methods.name: GenerateCompoundTypeWriteFieldMethod
methods.description: Creates a method for writing a field in a compound type serializer.

methods.name: GenerateCompoundTypeReadValueMethod
methods.description: Creates a method for reading a value in a compound type serializer.
